queries.result: 开平市自然资源局 official results identify the local cadastral/real-estate registration service. The guide says parcel maps are viewed after QR/certificate or real-estate-unit verification; no anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was available.

sourceNotes: The Kaiping Natural Resources Bureau is the local administrative custodian; its official site links to 不动产登记以图查房（地籍图）查询.

The Kaiping guide states that post-2024-07-19 records use QR scanning plus the final character of the right-holder name, while earlier records use the Jiangmen Natural Resources WeChat flow with unit/certificate number and verification.

The Guangdong Public Map Service site was inspected as a provincial first-party viewer. Its current configuration exposed an administrative-boundary VectorTileServer and general basemap/terrain assets, not a cadastral parcel feature layer.
